stages.prompt: Read content/<content-id>/content.json and brief.md. If the brief lacks any of the 7 intake headings in AGENTS.md (topic, audience/language, format, creative direction, narrative, audio/post, budget), ask the user for the missing ones. Then write the complete brief into brief.md. Do not generate media.

Read config/workspace.json, config/brands/<brand>/ and content.json. Confirm the brand exists, every locale is active, and Arabic is Khaliji/Emirati. Report mismatches; fix only content.json fields the user confirms.
Show the user the finished brief and wait. Mark this stage completed only after their explicit yes.
